target_reference_entry:
[240] Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai Zhang,
and Sanglu Lu. Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing
sub-mm level vibration. Proceedings of ACM IMWUT (UbiComp), 2020.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在介绍侧信道麦克风的相关工作时，将[240]列为利用非声学硬件实现语音窃听的示例之一，属于普通的文献列举，未单独描述或评价该目标论文的具体贡献。

evidences.evidence_context: The pervasive use of speech communication devices amplifies the potential threats of speech eavesdropping. ... Recent research indicates that non-acoustic hardware, such as motion sensors [153, 32, 34, 39, 209, 80], actuators [151, 192, 138], communication devices [255, 240, 271, 133, 254], storage devices [125], radars [52, 75, 268, 238, 288, 279, 54], cameras [63, 141], and instruments [169, 168, 286, 195], can create a side channel to eavesdrop the speech generated by humans or loudspeakers.
